_about: Story-type catalogue for the story engine (research/story/04_arcs_in_the_engine.md). Generated by tools/story/make_story_types.py. Roles are Greimas actants with eligibility over the psychology tokens (research/psychology/tokens.json); beats come from the named template; shape = Reagan et al. emotional arc for the subject; mythoi = Frye outcome families allowed; value = McKee value pair the arc turns; reach = who beyond the principals it touches.
